info.title: Social Media App Server API
info.description: API documentation derived from the Express routes and Mongoose models. Successful operations generally return HTTP 200. Errors are plain text. JWTs use the x-auth-token header. Login and registration share a limit of 20 requests per client IP per 15 minutes outside tests. Request sanitization removes object keys beginning with $ or containing a dot. Only routes mounted in startup/routes.ts are documented; chat and message models have no mounted HTTP endpoints.

Checks the separate Like collection. With no existing Like record it increments the post counter; with an existing record it attempts to delete it and decrement. This endpoint does not create a Like record. The current unlike branch checks a legacy deletion result field and may leave the request without a response.

delete.description: The handler currently checks a legacy deletion result field. With the installed Mongoose version it may return 400 Unable to delete after removing the post. The documented 200 response is the handler's success branch.
